text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-2026: prober-noisy-firing (prober_synth_checks)
incident-bot: Alert details: failure_rate=6.4% over 5m in eu-west-1, tests: /v1/health/synth, threshold=5%.
pagerduty-bot: Triggered on schedule policy 'synth-critical'. Paging: @sam (primary) -> @sre-rotation (escalation).
sam: acked: taking first look. will pull logs and check if customer-facing.
maya: on call backup — pinged, can join in 2m if needed.
sam: quick check: not seeing 5xx spikes in prod app logs, only prober runners show timeouts and short 502 fragments to internal probe endpoint. looks like synthetic runner issues, not app backend.
leo: running query against probe runner metrics: `sum(rate(prober_request_failures_total[5m])) by (region)` -> eu-west is elevated, other regions OK.
leo: also see a subtle surge in `prober_concurrent_jobs` around 10:01 UTC. might be a scheduling hiccup.
maya: can we mute noisy duplicates? propose silencing PD on this service while we triage to avoid wakeups.
sam: +1. silencing now for 15m while we investigate. `pagerduty-bot: Silenced INC-2026 for 15 minutes by sam`
ops: FYI I'm seeing a deploy window overlap at 09:58-10:04 in eu-west infra. rollout to prober-runner fleet started at 09:59.
maya: that lines up. maybe the runner binary had a regression causing retry storms. can someone grab runner logs from a host?
leo: pulling logs from runner-42 in eu-west-1: ```
2026-04-02T09:59:58Z INFO starting job
2026-04-02T09:59:59Z WARN request timeout to http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
2026-04-02T10:00:00Z ERROR job failed after 3 retries
2026-04-02T10:00:01Z INFO retrying job (backoff=0s)
```
maya: backoff=0s looks wrong. config change in deploy likely dropped exponential backoff. that would cause thundering retries and increase observed failures.
sam: rolling temporary mitigation: toggle `prober.retry.backoff.enabled=false` -> wait, that's inverted, need to set true. I'll push config rollback to previous release on the prober fleet.
emily: how much customer impact? any 5xx seen by customers or only synth?
sam: so far only synth spikes. no increase in user-reported errors, frontend error rate normal. marking customer impact: low / no-customer-facing.
maya: proceeding to rollback prober config on a single canary host, then roll if stable. I'll take the action and update.
maya: rolled back config on runner-canary-3 at 10:06 UTC. observed immediate drop in retry volume and failure rate on that runner.
leo: metrics after rollback (1m): eu-west failure_rate down from 6.4% -> 0.9% on canary subset. whole fleet trending down.
ops: keeping PD silenced. if the rate stays down for 10m we can un-silence and auto-close.
sam: handing off primary to maya for the remainder of the window. @maya you own followups; I'll stay reachable.
maya: taking it. plan: monitor for 20m, iterate rollback to rest of fleet, file postmortem note with timeline and root cause (deploy dropped backoff flag).
sre-rotation: noted. I'll update the on-call rotation log and ensure the incident is routed to infra owners for the deploy pipeline.
incident-bot: INC-2026 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (silenced + rollback) by sam/maya.
maya: final check: no customer errors, synth failure rate back to baseline, un-silencing PD in 12m to verify no regression.
sam: tl;dr for pager summary: PD fired due to prober retry storm during deploy; no customer-facing impact; mitigated by rolling back prober backoff flag; monitoring continues.
emily: thanks team. please add impacted service tags and note deploy window correlation in postmortem. :thumbsup:
maya: will do, drafting postmortem skeleton now and assigning to `infra-prober` owners.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 auto-closed after 30m of stable metrics.
